desc: Explore candidate approaches, including per-value DP, occurrence-gap processing, prefix-sum optimization, and divide-and-conquer formulations.
Identify the fixed-value DP recurrence and lazy global-update framework.
Correct candidate activation for values first occurring after a nonempty prefix.
Prove that activation and segment-tree maintenance correctly model contiguous subarrays after deleting all occurrences of one value.
Validate against exhaustive brute force, provided examples, all-negative arrays, single-element arrays, repeated values, and deletion choices that remove every element.
Produce the final `maxSubarraySum(self, nums: List[int]) -> int` implementation.
